name: @mymehq/integration-mymehq-inbox
description: Email-to-Myme capture. Receives emails sent to a Myme-managed address (inbox.myme.so) via Cloudflare Email Routing → Email Worker, signs them with HMAC-SHA256, and lands each delivery as a `mymehq.captured_email` item. Substrate-shaped: no upstream API, no OAuth, no token — the substrate itself IS the upstream.
